core_categories: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Devices; Patient Monitors; Medical Devices
specialty_focus: eDevice provides global IoT connectivity solutions, specializing in secure data transmission for the medical and telehealth industries. It bridges medical devices and cloud systems using specialized hardware, custom cellular networks, and software. eDevice Products & Technology HealthGO / HealthGO+: Award-winning medical telehealth hubs and touchscreen platforms that capture and transmit vital signs (blood pressure, blood glucose, weight, SpO2) to the cloud.
